notes.title: Switching to free to play model
notes.notes: In the coming period, there are clear efforts to make Neon Knight a free to play title. After a short analysis, this seems to be the best move that will contribute to a better experience for the players. In this case, those players who have already bought the game at the standard price will have additional benefits in the coming period. Talk to you soon. All the best.

notes.title: Safe Mode Launcher Update 2
notes.notes:
[b]Now Neon Knight:VFTG can be started with Safe Mode Launcher v:1.2.[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32121145/57a5fd68e03ce9d40a544ad435ed5122fa02da6e.jpg[/img]
This is second, improved version of  the existing safe mode launcher. This launcher is intended for users who have problematic experience with the game in the form of crashing, impossibility and difficulty in starting a certain level in the game. The launcher has proved to be extremely effective in these cases, removing the above problems and featuring following changes and upgrades:

[b]-Easier level startup
-Removed "pause and scroll" crashing problem
-Improved overall oprimization
-Reduced load and memory usage
-Changed level link structure[/b]

[i]*None of the changes above will affect ingame content and presentation.
*Joystick control is disabled while using this launcher.
*Changes to options in the main (regular started) menu are applied in this game instance.[/i]

Further software improvements are currently underway.
Thank you for playing.

Marko Vukovic

This launcher is intended for users who have problematic experience with the game (in the form of crashing, impossibility and difficulty in starting a certain level in the game). The launcher has proved to be extremely effective in these cases, removing the above problems. It should be kept in mind that in a small number of cases, the launcher fails to solve the problems, but still ,currently it is an optimal and recommended solution.  Software improvements are currently underway.

Marko Vukovic

notes.title: Neon Knight's release date
notes.notes:
After a while, I think it's time to bring the end of Neon Knight's development story. I am pleased to inform you that the development of the game has been completed and that only a couple of days have left until the official release on STEAM. The definitive release date is [b]November 30th[/b]. 
Until then ... all the best. 
Marko VUkovic

notes.title: Neon Knight: Vengeance From The Grave on Steam
notes.notes:
During the last few days, Neon Knight has finally been released on the steam in the "coming soon" section. It has been in development for some time now, but the dice are slowly folding, and everything goes ahead. As you will have the opportunity to see on the page, the release date is roughly fixed in April 2018, but fewer changes are possible, but not dramatic ones. In any case, the main thing is that the game is on the steam, it is alive and you are welcome to leave your comment, opinion, or question in here.

All the best, Marko Vukovic.
